assessment_scope: All pages were traversed for text extraction; first, middle, and last pages were rendered and visually inspected for each PDF.
visual_quality_result: All fifteen sampled renders were legible, correctly oriented, unclipped, and consistent with scholarly article layouts; reaction schemes, spectra, kinetic plots, tables, and references rendered correctly.

items.title: Nano-structured Magnesium Oxide as Efficient Recyclable Catalyst for Knoevenagel and Claisen-Schmidt Condensation Reactions
items.reason: Reusable heterogeneous-catalysis study covering recyclable nano-MgO and solvent-free carbon-carbon bond formation.

items.title: Continuous production of benzylideneacetophenone via gas phase reaction of benzaldehyde and acetophenone: Mechanism and reaction kinetics
items.reason: High-value process and kinetics study linking catalyst basicity, selectivity, continuous operation, and Langmuir-Hinshelwood modelling.

items.title: Effective Heterogeneous MoOx-Modified CeO2 Catalyst for Michael Addition of Dimethyl Malonate to 2-Cyclohexen-1-one
items.reason: High-value mechanistic catalyst study identifying the isolated MoOx-CeO2 interface as an active site for reusable Michael addition.

items.title: Synthesis of Chalcones: An Improved High-Yield and Substituent-Independent Protocol for an Old Structure
items.reason: Reusable robust synthesis protocol comparing aldol and Wittig routes across substituent classes with yield and purity evidence.

items.title: Synthesis, reactions and application of chalcones: a systematic review
items.reason: Broad systematic review connecting chalcone synthesis, transformations, structure-activity relations, biological applications, toxicity, and safety.
